note.title: js analysis & secrets extraction
note.intro: analise de arquivos javascript e onde mora o ouro. endpoints escondidos, chaves de api, configuracoes de firebase, urls internas, feature flags. apps modernos empacotam tudo no frontend e expõem muito mais do que dev imagina.
commands:
# katana com js extraction
katana -u https://alvo.com -d 3 -jc -silent -o urls.txt

# filtrar so .js
grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" urls.txt | sort -u > js_files.txt

# gau (wayback + common crawl)
gau alvo.com --subs | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u >> js_files.txt

# waybackurls
waybackurls alvo.com | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u >> js_files.txt

# f12 > sources > cmd+shift+p > "open all files"
# ou copiar via puppeteer
python3 -c "
import subprocess, json
# headless chromium pega todos js carregados
subprocess.run(['chromium', '--headless', '--dump-dom', 'https://alvo.com'])
"

# muitos sites servem .js.map em prod (dev esquece de desligar)
ffuf -u https://alvo.com/FUZZ -w js_files.txt -mc 200 | grep "\.map$"

# ou adicionar .map ao final de cada js
cat js_files.txt | sed 's/$/.map/' | httpx -silent -mc 200 -o sourcemaps.txt

# restaurar source original do sourcemap
npx source-map-explorer bundle.js.map
# ou
unwebpack-sourcemap bundle.js.map -o restored_src/

# acha endpoints /api/v1/usuarios etc dentro de js
python3 linkfinder.py -i https://alvo.com/bundle.js -o cli

# batch
cat js_files.txt | while read url; do
  python3 linkfinder.py -i "$url" -o cli
done > all_endpoints.txt

# alternativa rapida: regex direto
cat downloaded/*.js | grep -oP '(\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/\.]+(?:api|v[0-9]|graphql|rest)[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/\.]*)' | sort -u

# secretfinder (gerhart/python)
python3 SecretFinder.py -i https://alvo.com/bundle.js -o cli

# trufflehog (git + filesystem)
trufflehog filesystem downloaded_js/
trufflehog github --org=alvo

# gitleaks em dir
gitleaks detect --source=downloaded_js/ --report-path=leaks.json

# chaves mais comuns
grep -rEnE "(api[_-]?key|apikey|api[_-]?secret|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|bearer|client[_-]?secret|aws[_-]?(access|secret)|firebase|stripe_|sk_live_|pk_live_|ghp_|gho_|xox[bap]-|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}" downloaded_js/ > secrets.txt

# urls internas
grep -oP 'https?:\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.(alvo\.com|internal|local|dev|staging)[a-zA-Z0-9\/_\-\.]*' downloaded_js/*.js | sort -u

# firebase
grep -oP '[a-z0-9\-]+\.firebaseio\.com' downloaded_js/*.js | sort -u

# s3 buckets
grep -oP '[a-z0-9\-]+\.s3[\-a-z]*\.amazonaws\.com' downloaded_js/*.js | sort -u

# registra estado dos js e avisa quando muda
jsmon -u alvo.com -o jsmon_baseline.json
jsmon -u alvo.com -c jsmon_baseline.json  # diff

# fetch + extract secrets + endpoints em uma tool
jsfscan -u https://alvo.com -o jsfscan_out/

# identificar chunks
grep -oP '[a-z0-9]+\.bundle\.[a-z0-9]+\.js' downloaded_js/index.js

# muitos bundles tem admin/auth separados — buscar
ffuf -u https://alvo.com/static/js/FUZZ.js -w chunk_names.txt -mc 200

# restore via sourcemap
npx reverse-sourcemap bundle.js.map -o restored/

#!/bin/bash
DOMAIN=$1
OUTDIR="recon/$DOMAIN/js"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

echo "[*] coletando js..."
katana -u "https://$DOMAIN" -d 3 -jc -silent -o "$OUTDIR/urls.txt"
gau "$DOMAIN" --subs | grep -E "\.js$|\.js\?" | sort -u >> "$OUTDIR/urls.txt"
sort -u "$OUTDIR/urls.txt" -o "$OUTDIR/urls.txt"

echo "[*] baixando..."
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR/raw"
cd "$OUTDIR/raw"
while read url; do
  fname=$(echo "$url" | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
  curl -s "$url" -o "$fname.js"
done < ../urls.txt
cd -

echo "[*] sourcemaps..."
cat ../urls.txt | sed 's/$/.map/' | httpx -silent -mc 200 -o "$OUTDIR/sourcemaps.txt"

echo "[*] endpoints (linkfinder)..."
cat "$OUTDIR/urls.txt" | while read url; do
  python3 ~/tools/linkfinder/linkfinder.py -i "$url" -o cli 2>/dev/null
done > "$OUTDIR/endpoints.txt"

echo "[*] secrets (trufflehog)..."
trufflehog filesystem "$OUTDIR/raw/" --json > "$OUTDIR/secrets.json"

echo "[*] regex manual..."
grep -rEnE "(api[_-]?key|secret|token|firebase|stripe_|sk_live_|ghp_)" "$OUTDIR/raw/" > "$OUTDIR/regex_hits.txt"

echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/urls.txt") js files"
echo "[+] $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/endpoints.txt") endpoints"
echo "[+] $(jq '. | length' "$OUTDIR/secrets.json" 2>/dev/null) secrets verificados"
echo "[+] sourcemaps: $(wc -l < "$OUTDIR/sourcemaps.txt")"
checklist: Trufflehog no diretorio de js baixados?
Regex manual de padroes conhecidos rodado?
paragraphs: analise de arquivos javascript e onde mora o ouro. endpoints escondidos, chaves de api, configuracoes de firebase, urls internas, feature flags. apps modernos empacotam tudo no frontend e expõem muito mais do que dev imagina.
wayback arquiva versões velhas de js que podem ter chaves revogadas mas endpoints ainda vivos. sempre rodar gau alem do katana ativo
.js.map em producao e vazamento de codigo fonte. nao so endpoints e secrets — tem logica de negocio, comentarios, nome real de devs. reportavel em bb se o programa cobrir information disclosure
trufflehog verifica chaves com fingerprint real da api (aws, gcp, stripe, github). grep acha padrao, mas muitos falsos positivos. cruzar os dois
